plugins.name: workbuddy-connect
plugins.description: Reuse the signed-in WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI desktop app session to give ZCode its model catalog, chat, credit balance and diagnostics over MCP tools, and expose the same models through a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that ZCode registers as a normal model provider. Zero configuration: credentials are read from the desktop app's own auth file, refreshed into a plugin-owned copy, and never written back. Protocol ported from corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect (MIT).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 复用已登录的 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 桌面应用登录态，为 ZCode 提供模型目录、对话、积分余额与诊断等 MCP 工具；同时通过本地 OpenAI 兼容桥把 WorkBuddy 模型注册进 ZCode 的模型选择器与模型设置页
